description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5340015489123 RETAINER RING,ASSEM: Line 0001 Qty 33 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0081 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
